notes.title: Shoot & Sow Patch 0.2.1
notes.notes:
Patch note for 0.2.1
Added the option to enable manual shooting in the game settings
(When developing the game, the best method of aiming was not chosen, so problems arose when reworking the possibility of manual shooting)

notes.title: Shoot & Sow Patch 0.2
notes.notes:
Patch note for 0.2
Start of Early Access

 Improved balance
 Added unlocking system using achievements (progress, for characters, weapons, items, trigger items)
 Changed "Day" difficulties
 Added 8 characters
 Added 6 weapons
Now there are different weapons available for each character
Also, weapons are now unlocked through achievements (progress)
 Added 17 items
 Added 15 trigger items
 Talent tree increased by 124 points
Weapon unlocking has been removed from the talent tree, now large nodes give % for weapon scaling
 Added 4 bosses
Now you get bonus coins and experience for every 10% of the boss's health
 Added 5 enemies
 Added first season, maple leaf
Access is granted after at least 3 characters receive 3 stars
For completing a character in maple leaf mode, you receive points that can be spent on enhancements
 Added new room mode
